title: Count Every Word
goal: One line creates or finds the counter; the next line bumps it through the reference.
hints: get only reads. You need find-or-create.
entry hands back a reference. The star reaches through it.
explanation: `get` returns an `Option` and never inserts - the counting idiom is `entry(key).or_insert(0)`, which returns `&mut i32`, creating the zero first when the word is new. Because `count` is a reference, `count += 1` is E0368; you bump the value it points at with `*count += 1`. Indexing with `map[..]` panics on missing keys - exactly what a counter meets on every first sighting.
